summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues the weekly series on Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) by Ibn al-Qayyim al-Jawziyyah, Part 30. The lecture focuses on a powerful hadith from Sahih Muslim about the Day of Judgment, where every person will stand before Allah without intermediaries and be directly addressed about their deeds. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) describes how people will see their good deeds on the right and bad deeds on the left, with only the Fire before them. Sh. Ali emphasizes that salvation comes through Allah's mercy, not personal achievements, and even the Prophet himself stated he would only enter Paradise through Allah's mercy. The speaker addresses the modern challenge of shortened attention spans caused by media overstimulation, arguing that traditional Islamic knowledge-seeking requires sustained focus and demands personal transformation, not mere entertainment.
suggested_title: The Day of Judgment: Standing Before Allah Without Intermediaries - Zadul-Ma'ad Part 30
catchy_title: What happens when you stand alone before Allah?
